subject: [hw] V41 rev 5 for review: power API (VENC only), list_free drain, EOS flush, wait_done sync; 630/630
body:
V41 rev 5 is ready for review. Host-only; no phone, no publish. Acceptance:

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
  V41 build asan PASS 591/591
  V41 build o2 PASS 591/591
  V41 build tsan PASS 591/591
  V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
  V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
  V41 layout PASS 63 lines match the kernel header
  V41 armv7 layout PASS (mtk_venc_ipi.h static asserts)
  V41 ios compile PASS (n2ap_venc.c, n2vc_dma.c for arm64-apple-ios16.0)
  N2TEST V41 PASS 630/630

What changed since the rev 3 you accepted (578/578):
- ap/n2ap_venc.c/.h: new public n2ap_venc_power(e,on) (reference counted, shared with POWER_ON/OFF, only RWVC_BLK_VENC per hw-k02) and ven_power_ref no longer takes VENC_C1; every successful encode drains venc_vsi.list_free before the result lookup (kernel sync-mode mtk_enc_put_buf; needed for the seq-hdr size); FRAME_FINAL with frame_handle 0 is the EOS flush; wait_done now uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC and syncs the bitstream from_device when the async result arrives; usleep replaced by nanosleep (IP's -Werror report).
- ap/n2vc_dma.c: an AP-registered entry survives the daemon's ion_munmap (ap_owned); guest_forget releases it. This was IV's carry patch, now owned and tested.
- ap/test_v41/t_v41.c: fake daemon grew encode_ack/free_without_put/put_buffer_late modes; new tests for the power API refcount, VENC_C1 staying 0, encode_fd's input_fd/bs_fd, async ACK+late PUT_BUFFER, wait_done timeout, seq-hdr list_free-only, EOS flush, and the atomic ring count (TSan-clean).
- ap/MESSAGE_FLOW.md updated for all of the above.

Worth a careful look: (a) the unconditional drain reading a ring an async daemon may fill concurrently — count is acquire/release, and wait_done owns the result path; (b) wait_done's newest-nonzero fallback could hide a mismatched cookie (single-job assumption, documented); (c) n2ap_venc_power's refcount interacting with a daemon's unbalanced POWER_ON; close drops leftovers and reports the first error; (d) the new tests' fake daemon races (TSan runs clean on the threaded mode).

Integration evidence on the plain tree: fakevenc/run_session.sh -> 115841-byte H.264 validated; host/run_vhost.sh -> same; host/test_iv -> N2TEST IV PASS 72/72; make -C host lib -> 34/34 objects san+o2.

Full detail and the honest not-done list: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md.
